author: Huawei
description:
A digital renaissance is unfolding at Padula Charterhouse, Italy's largest monastery and a UNESCO World Heritage site. The site has transformed into a hub where culture and community can thrive in the digital age, inviting young professionals and innovators to create, collaborate and build companies together.
 
With a fully optical FTTO network delivered by #Huawei, the site now supports cloud computing, collaboration tools and videoconferencing that help fuel learning, creativity and growth. Watch to discover more: https://bit.ly/3Ze2ZZW
title: Revitalizing a UNESCO Monastery for the Digital Age
